title: A payment was recorded twice
summary: A non-destructive verification process for suspected duplicate records before correcting financial history.
contentNotice: Demonstration playbook for interface validation. It is not final MOSCATELLI policy and must be reviewed before operational use.
scenario: Use this when two records appear to represent the same payment, expense or supplier transaction.
immediateAction: Do not delete either record until the duplication is verified against the underlying transaction evidence.
Compare amount, currency, date, supplier/reference and supporting receipt or invoice.
Mark the suspected duplicate for review using the available non-destructive workflow; preserve the audit trail.

whoToInform.when: Once the suspected duplicate is identified.
The correction changes reporting, a supplier balance or an approved commitment.

whatToRecord: Correction taken and who approved it
escalationConditions: The underlying transaction itself may have been paid twice.
The records differ in a way that cannot be reconciled from evidence.
Removing/correcting the duplicate would materially change a reported total.
